title: Hezekiah Shows His Treasures

questions.question: At that time Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of where, sent envoys with letters?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 39:1 (ESV): "Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon,"

questions.question: Hezekiah welcomed them gladly and showed them his what?
Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and said to him, "What did these men say? And from where did they come to you?" Hezekiah said, "They have come to me from a far country, from where?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 39:3 (ESV): "They have come to me from a far country, from Babylon."

questions.question: Behold, the days are coming, when all that is in your house... shall be carried to where?
Nothing shall be what, says the LORD?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 39:6 (ESV): "Nothing shall be left, says the LORD."

questions.question: And some of your own sons, who will come from you... shall be what in the palace of the king of Babylon?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 39:7 (ESV): "and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."

questions.question: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "The word of the LORD that you have spoken is what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 39:8 (ESV): "The word of the LORD that you have spoken is good."

questions.question: For he thought, "There will be peace and security in my what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 39:8 (ESV): "There will be peace and security in my days."

questions.question: What did Hezekiah show them besides the silver and gold?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 39:2 (ESV): "the silver, the gold, the spices, the precious oil,"

questions.question: Was there anything in his house or in all his realm that Hezekiah did not show them?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 39:2 (ESV): "There was nothing in his house or in all his realm that Hezekiah did not show them."

questions.question: Why did Merodach-baladan send letters and a present?
options: For he heard that he had been sick and had recovered
questions.correctAnswer: For he heard that he had been sick and had recovered
questions.explanation: Isaiah 39:1 (ESV): "for he heard that he had been sick and had recovered."

questions.question: This event prophecies the future what?
Hezekiah's response "The word of the LORD... is good" suggests what attitude?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 39:8 (He was glad there would be peace in *his* days).

questions.question: Where did the envoys come from?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 39:3 (ESV): "They have come to me from a far country, from Babylon."

key_verse_text: Behold, the days are coming, when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up till this day, shall be carried to Babylon. Nothing shall be left, says the LORD.
